company.name: Veho
company.shortDescription: Veho provides technology-enabled parcel delivery and logistics services for ecommerce brands.
company.description: Veho provides technology-enabled parcel delivery and logistics services for ecommerce brands. The company operates a network of warehouses and delivery partners to support last-mile shipping, including next-day and two-day delivery, while providing brands and customers with delivery tracking, flexible delivery options, and customer support.

productsAndServices.description: Technology-enabled parcel delivery for ecommerce brands, with next-day and two-day options, transparent pricing, shipment visibility, and delivery support.

productsAndServices.name: Last Mile Delivery

productsAndServices.description: Middle-mile and parcel transportation services connecting warehouses, sortation facilities, and delivery networks through pickup, direct injection, and customized logistics programs.
productsAndServices.name: Transportation Solutions

items.description: Veho and RIVR have announced a new partnership to deploy AI-powered delivery robots for e-commerce deliveries, starting with a launch in Austin, Texas, and plans to expand to additional markets later in the year. The collaboration aims to improve delivery efficiency and customer experience by pairing human drivers with robots for last-mile delivery.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $170,000,000, or 56.83% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,422,959 to $1,500,000,000, a 131.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
